what_the_world_showed: failures of v14 were mostly WALL contacts (17.5-18.5 % of episodes), not aircraft contacts (3-4 %): real single flights showed two wall crashes but could not show that walls, not aircraft, dominated

the walls are hit where the canyon narrows ahead (pinch entrance x 30.5-31.5, north-wall end face at x 25.5, south jet): the drone arrives with |y| 1.3-1.6 m and 1.5-3.5 m/s of lateral velocity left over from an avoidance turn or a jet stronger than the prior; my wall barrier only looked at the nearest wall here and now

my C24 change (moving keep-out 0.9 -> 1.2 m, made after one real collision) cost ~7 points: larger keep-outs mean larger lateral manoeuvres that end on walls; across sweeps smaller keep-outs (0.6 / 1.3) were better
v13 was better than v14 (86 vs 77 %) -- the opposite of what three real successes of v14 suggested
pursuer-specific handling (my reading of real close-range reactions) did not help against the world's guards
